svg.title: Board transition -> proposal -> kernel guard -> intent -> role router -> spawn with an idempotent key -> goal revision published

g.text: Board transition -> proposal -> kernel guard -> intent -> role router -> spawn with an idempotent key -> goal revision published
version in force D7, generation g12:
[kernel predicate fails, or rev / generation changed]
no standing session; role profile + pin; target local
profile developer, expect_pin, binding X/repo rev,
host_start under admitted permit; dispatcher invokes privileged launcher
agent-side executor/holder starts after UID drop
goal.revise TASK-42 (goal_id G42, rev 1, until = exit guards)
goal.publish{G42, rev 1, digest, RUN-981, session} (board identity)
schedules nudges for (G42, rev 1); bridge calls host enqueue
swarm-tail goal clear --done (board slot; SH1 outcome proposal only, D-GOALS)
evaluate under the version in force now (generation check)
[version changed and state no longer admits the role]
refused (stale run); root orchestrator owns the element
notice to the orchestrator; delivery record back to active
next owner spawns the same way
SH1 board goal clear --blocked, or a no-progress result, becomes
a notice to the orchestrator or a person, never a transition.
